old:
정착민들은 병력도 없이 나선 전쟁맹약단의 어리석음을 듣고 웃었다. 농부의 능숙한 이야기에 찬사를 보내며 술잔을 들어 올렸다.

그때 숲지기가 처음으로 입을 열었다. 몇 년 동안 쓰지 않은 듯 거친 목소리였다. “나만 아는 이야기가 하나 있소. 그걸 본 사람 중 나 말고 살아 있는 자가 없으니까.” 막 도착한 순례자와 정착민들은 섬사람의 기묘한 어조와 매혹적인 비밀에 이끌려 몸을 앞으로 기울였다.

“옛날에 바라린(Varalin)의 처녀가 살았소. 해변의 모래처럼 순수하고 고결했지. 어찌나 사랑받고 정숙했는지, 흘러내리는 드레스의 가장 먼 자락에도 추문이라는 얼룩 하나 묻지 않았소.

“그녀의 아버지는 요새의 주인을 보좌하는 고문이었소. 무척 바쁘고 중요한 인물이었던지라 그레이브할에 늘 머물렀고, 십여 명의 시녀를 붙여 딸을 곁에서 감시하게 했지.

“어느 날 문득, 소녀는 요새 안뜰에서 평화롭게 분주히 돌아다니는 야수를 구경하고 싶어졌소. 시녀들을 따돌리고 그레이브할의 야수 조련사를 찾아갔지. 남자는 우리 옆에서 코를 골며 자고 있었소. 게으름 피우다 낮잠을 잔 게 아니라, 열심히 일한 대가로 쉬던 참이었지.

“그녀가 말을 걸자 남자는 한쪽 눈만 떠서 잠을 깨운 사람이 누군지 보았소. 전해지는 말로는 그 한쪽 눈만으로도 처녀의 마음을 사로잡기에 충분했다더군. 얼음처럼 푸르고 바다처럼 깊은 눈이 그녀를 꿰뚫었고, 한 번도 느껴 본 적 없는 감정으로 채웠소. 야수 조련사도 그걸 느꼈는지 다른 쪽 눈까지 뜨고 그녀를 똑바로 바라보았지.

“그녀가 더듬거리며 물었소. ‘어떻게 그토록 거칠고 길들지 않은 야수들을 찾아내시며, 어떤 마법으로 그들을 뜻대로 다루시나요?’

“‘말로 설명하기보다 직접 보여 드리는 편이 낫겠군요, 아가씨. 하지만 귀하신 아버님이나 늘 뒤를 졸졸 따라다니는 수다스러운 시녀들에게 들키지 않으려면 요새 담장 너머로 이어지는 은밀한 길을 찾아야 합니다. 자, 지하 통로로 갑시다. 한 번도 본 적 없는 걸 보여 드리겠습니다.’

“바라린의 처녀는 더없이 기뻤소. 야수보다 더 좋아하는 건 아무것도 없었지. 적어도 남자답고 든든한 야수 조련사를 보기 전까지는 말이오. 오늘은 분명 다른 어떤 날보다 특별할 터였소.

“그는 그녀를 통로로 이끌었소. 주인 나리는 신하들과 말을 타고 스캐브 따위를 사냥하러 나가 왕좌의 방은 비어 있었지. 연인들은 화려한 타일이 깔린 통로로 숨어들어, 저편으로 이어지는 거대한 아치에서 보이지 않는 곳까지 갔소.

“바다 냄새가 처녀를 감쌌고, 짭짤한 공기는 걸음을 옮길 때마다 그녀를 더욱 취하게 했소. 한 시간쯤 걸었을까, 야수 조련사는 섬의 모든 해변으로 갈라지는 통로 앞에서 멈춰 섰소. 횃불 아래서 본 그의 눈은 안뜰에서 봤을 때보다 한층 더 매혹적인 푸른빛이었다고 하오.

“‘도착했습니다.’ 그가 말했소. ‘바라린 섬 전체에서 가장 사납고 굶주린 야수가 숨은 곳이지요.’

“‘어머나!’ 그녀가 외쳤소. ‘지금 여기 있나요?’

“‘물론입니다, 아가씨. 그 야수를 굴에서 꾀어내고, 유혹하고, 뜻대로 굴복시키는 법을 가르쳐 드릴 생각입니다.’

“처녀는 흥분을 억누를 수 없었소. ‘제게 그걸 가르쳐 주시겠다고요? 거절할 리가 없잖아요! 어서 시작해요!’

“야수 조련사의 눈이 번뜩였고 입 한쪽에 미소가 번졌소. ‘아가씨가 원하시는 대로.’ 그가 나지막이 말했지. 그녀에게 등을 돌린 그는 몸 앞에서 온갖 주문 동작을 하는 듯했소.

“야수 조련사가 다시 바라린의 처녀 쪽으로 돌아섰을 때, 그의 손에 들려 있던 것은 바로…”

english:
The band of settlers chuckled to hear of the folly of the unmanned Warsworn and lay praise upon and raised toasts to the farmer for his able telling.

It was then that the woodsman first spoke, his voice brambled as if it hadn't been called to use in years. "I have a tale none but me know, for no others who saw it still live." The newly arrived pilgrims and settlers leaned forth, fascinated by the strange tones and beguiling secrets of this man of the island.

"Once there was a maid of Varalin, pure and noble as the sands of the beach. So beloved and chaste was she that no stain of scandal had appeared on even the furthest hem of her flowing dresses.

"Her father, an advisor to the Master of the Keep, was ever in residence in Gravehal and kept his daughter close to him and under the gaze of a dozen handmaids, for he was a very busy and important fellow.

"One day, on a whim, the girl fancied to look up on the wild beasts that dwelled so peacefully and busily in the keep's courtyard, so she stole away from her handmaids and sought out the beast master of Gravehal. The man of the keep was snoring beside his pen, a well earned rest I might add, not the loungings of a layabout.

"When she spoke to him, he opened but one eye to see who had disturbed his slumber. That one eye, it's said, was all it took to capture the maiden's heart. Blue as ice and deep as the sea, it pierced her and filled her with such feelings as she'd never known. The Beast Master must have felt it too, as he opened the other eye to look full upon her.

'Wherefore,' she stammered, 'do you find such wild and untamable creatures and what magic brings them so under your control?'

'Tis better to show you, my lady, than to tell. But we needst to find a more secretive route beyond the keep walls lest we be seen by your noble father or the clucking hens that are ever in your wake. Come. Let's to the tunnel and I will show you something you've never before beheld.'

"The maid of Varalin was overjoyed. She loved nothing more than beasts, at least she hadn't until she looked upon the beast master, manly and comforting as he was. Surely this would be a day to rival all others.

"He led her to the tunnel. The throne room was empty as his lordship was ahorse with his court, hunting scavs and the like. The lovers stole into the ornately tiled tunnel and out of sight of the massive archway that led hence.

"The smell of the sea washed over the maid, the briny air intoxicating her more with every step. They walked, it seemed, for an hour when the beast master stopped at a place where the tunnels branched out to every beach on the island. In the torchlight, it is said, his eyes were an even more enthralling blue than she'd seen in the courtyard.

"'We have arrived,' he said, 'in the hiding place of the fiercest, hungriest beast in all of Isle Varalin.'

"'Oh my!' she exclaimed. 'Is it here now?'

"'It is indeed, my lady. And I intend to teach you how to roust it out from its den, beguile it, and bend it to your will.'

"The maid's excitement could not be contained. 'You would teach me this? I could not possibly refuse! Let's begin without delay!'

"The beast master's eyes gleamed and a smile crept onto one side of his mouth. 'As the lady wishes,' he purred. He turned his back to her, and seemed to the maid to make many conjuring gestures before himself.

"When the beast master turned back to the maid of Varalin, he held before him…"

"ある時、ヴァラリンの乙女がいた。浜辺の砂のごとく純粋で気高かった。その愛くるしさと貞節ゆえ、流れるようなドレスには、すその先にさえ醜聞の染みがついていなかった"

"城の主君の助役であった彼女の父親は、とても忙しく責任ある人物で、常にグレイバルに住み、十余人の侍女に娘を見張らせて側に置いていた"

"ある日のこと。娘は出来心で、城の中庭で穏やかに歩き回っている野獣たちを見たいと考え、侍女たちを振り切ってグレイバルの猛獣使いを訪ねた。その男は筆を近くに置いていびきをかいていたが、それは怠け者の居眠りではなく、勤勉の代償であった"

"娘が声を書けると男は片側の目だけを開き、眠りを妨げるのは誰かと視線を向けた。その目だけでも、乙女の心を捕らえるには十分だったという。氷のように青く、海のように深く、男の眼差しは乙女を貫き、かつて感じたことのなかった感情で満たした。猛獣使いもそれに気づいたのか、残りの目も開けて正面から娘を見た"

"娘は口ごもりながら言った。"あのような自由な野生の動物たちをどちらで見つけ、どのような魔術で手なずけるのですか？"

"お話しするより、お見せした方がよいでしょう、お嬢様。ですが城から出るには目立たない道を探さねばなりません。偉大なるお父上か、行く手を絶えず邪魔する鶏たちに見とがめられるやもしれません。参りましょう、地下通路へ。目にしたことのないものを、お目にかけましょう"

"ヴァラリンの乙女は有頂天になった。少なくとも、男らしく、優しい猛獣使いを目にするまでは、獣以上に好きなものなどなかったのだ。きっとこの日は人生最高の日になるだろうと"

"男は乙女を通路へと導き、城の主は馬を駆り、臣下を連れてスキャブなどを狩っていたため玉座の間に人影はなく、愛しあう者たちはタイルが美しく並ぶ通路に入り、先へと続く巨大なアーチから見えない所まで歩いた"

"こちらです"、猛獣使いは言った。"ヴァラリン島全土で最も凶暴で、最も飢えたけだものの隠れる場所です"

"あらまあ！"乙女は息をのんだ。"今ここにいるのでしょうか？"

"おりますとも、お嬢様。そしてあなたにはそやつを巣から追い出し、手なずけ、意のままに操るすべをお教えするつもりです"

"そして猛獣使いがヴァラリンの乙女に向き直ると、その手にしかと握られていたのは、そのまさか…"
chinese:
听闻那名懦弱誓战者的愚蠢行为后，这群定居者咯咯地笑了起来，对这个农民的能言善道大加赞扬，并向他敬酒。

就在那时，樵夫第一次开口说话了，他的声音颤抖着，就好像多年都没有开口过一样。“我有一个故事，除了我自己谁也不知道，因为目睹过这个故事的人没有一个还活着。”新到的朝圣者们和定居者们倾身向前，被岛上这个人的奇怪语调和迷人秘密吸引住了。

“从前有一个瓦拉林的少女，她就像沙滩上的沙子纯洁而高贵。她是那么可爱，那么贞洁，就连她飘逸的衣裙的最边上也未曾出现过一丝污迹。

“她的父亲是城堡领主的幕僚，他一直住在格雷夫霍，把女儿养在自己身边，让十几个女仆看着，因为他是一个位高权重的大忙人。

“一天，姑娘突发奇想，想去看看那些安详而又忙碌地栖息在城堡院子里的野兽，于是，她偷偷地离开了她的女仆们，去找格雷夫霍的驯兽师。驯兽师在他的兽圈旁边打呼噜，我得说，这是他应得的休息，而不是懒汉的闲荡。

当她对他说话时，他只睁开了一只眼睛，想看看是谁打扰了他的睡眠。据说，他仅凭这一直眼睛就俘获了少女的芳心。那只眼睛像冰一样幽蓝、像海一样深邃，那目光刺穿了她，使她充满了从未有过的感觉。驯兽师一定也感受到了，因为他随即睁开了另一只眼睛，以便好好地打量她。

“为什么，”她结结巴巴地说，“你会发现这样狂野、难以驯服的动物，你是用了什么魔法让它们这么听命于你的？”

女士，百闻不如一见，我还是亲自向你演示比较好。但我们需要找到一条更隐秘的道路来越过城堡，以免被你高贵的父亲或一直追在你身后咯咯叫的母鸡们看见。来吧。我们到隧道里去，我给你看一件你从未见过的东西。”

“瓦拉林的少女大喜过望。她最喜欢的东西就是野兽，至少在她看到驯兽师之前，她是这样认为的。毫无疑问，这将是胜过所有其他日子的一天。

“他带她去了隧道。王座室空无一人，因为领主大人带着他的臣下们骑马猎杀吐酸虫之类的去了。这对恋人偷偷地溜进了铺着华丽瓷砖的隧道，走出了通向那里的巨大拱门。

“海水的气味向着少女扑面而来，咸咸的空气使她每走一步都更加陶醉。他们似乎走了一个小时，接着驯兽师停在了一个地方，那里的诸多隧道延伸到了岛上的每一片海滩。据说，在火把的光芒下，他的眼睛比她在院子里看到的还要迷人。

“‘我们已经到了，’他说，‘我们现在在瓦拉林岛最凶猛、最饥饿的野兽的藏身之处。'

“‘天哪！’她惊呼道。‘就是这里吗？'

“‘的确如此，女士。我要教你如何将它从洞里唤醒，引诱它，使它服从你的意志。'

“少女的激动无法抑制。‘你会教我这个？我无法拒绝！让我们立即开始吧！'

“驯兽师的眼睛闪着光，嘴角挂着一丝微笑。‘如您所愿，’他咕哝道。他转过身去背对着她，在少女看来，他似乎在自己面前做了许多魔法般的手势。

“当驯兽师转向瓦拉林的少女时，他站在了他的面前……"

english:
They're coming. The unholy apparitions have appeared, as if by dark magic, behind our defenses. Despite our well manned perimeter, we have been undone. With nary of drop of blood shed, nor a man lost, they are at our gates.

Lord Gravehal has commanded a full withdrawal and flight upon our ships, and not a man among us disagreed.

His lordship has ordered the keep burned to the ground and the task has fallen to me, but I cannot bring myself to set it alight.

This morning, I sought out the gnome mage, a visitor from the Scolia Arcana, to ward my beautiful palace against all intruders, by any means within his power. I do not know what the unseemly sorcerer has in mind, but he assures me that neither these apparitions nor anyone else will ever claim the keep.

I've devised to seal her entrances as best we can and steal away by the beach tunnel. His lordship has this morning departed, setting sail in an unassuming trading ship. I shall be the last out, entrusted with the destruction of my life's work. Though it pains me near as much as committing her to the fire, I've no choice but to seal the tunnel with explosives. I pray that this and the devisings of the mage will be sufficient to preserve the keep intact when ere we return to reclaim the island as our own.

奴らが来る。不浄なる者たちが、まるで妖術でも使ったかのように、我々の防衛線の内側に現れた。周辺警戒は十分に行なっていたものの、裏をかかれてしまったのだ。一滴の流血もなく、一人の消耗もなく、門前まで迫ってきているのだ。

グレイバル卿は全軍撤退と船での脱出を命じ、異を唱える者は一人もいなかった。

領主様は砦を焼き尽くすように指示を出され、私がその任を担うことになったものの、どうしても火を放てずにいる。

今朝、アルカナ大学からの訪問者であるノームの魔道士を訪ね、いかなる手を使ってでもあの美しい宮殿を侵入者から守ってくれるように頼み込んだ。あの斜に構えた魔道士がどんな手段を用いるつもりかはわからないが、あの不浄なる者たちであれ誰であれ、決して砦を奪うことはないだろうと保証してくれた。

城への入口をできる限り塞いだうえで、浜辺への地下道を通って脱出する手はずを整えた。領主様は今朝がた、目立たないように商船に乗り込んで出立された。私はしんがりとして、生涯をかけて築き上げてきたものの破壊を任されたのだ。焼き尽くすのと変わらぬほど胸が痛むものの、地下道を爆薬で崩さざるを得ない。魔道士の案ともども、これで我々が島を奪還しに戻ってきた時に砦が手つかずで残っていることを祈るばかりだ。
chinese:
他们要来了。就像某种黑魔法一样，邪恶的幽灵出现了，躲在我们的防御后面。尽管我们的防线有人把守，我们还是失败了。他们没有流一滴血，也没有一个伤亡，就来到了我们的门口。

格雷夫霍领主命令我们的船只全部撤退和逃跑，我们中间没有一个人不同意。

领主大人下令把城堡烧为平地，任务落在了我的身上，但我无法让自己把它点燃。

今天早上，我找到了侏儒法师——一个来自奥术学院的来客，来采取一切他力所能及的手段保护我美丽的宫殿不受任何入侵者的侵扰。我不知道那个不体面的巫师心里想的是什么，但他向我保证，无论是这些幽灵还是其他任何人，都不会得到这个城堡。

我已经想好了，尽可能地封住城堡的入口，然后从海滩隧道溜走。今天早晨，领主大人驾着一艘不起眼的商船离开了。我将是最后一个离开的人，被委以毁灭我毕生事业的重任。虽然这和把城堡付之一炬一样让我痛苦，但我别无选择，只能用炸药封住隧道。我祈祷这个连同法师的装备一起，能足够让我们在回归之前完整地保存这座岛屿。

english:
The desecration of our keep by the monster Draug has put his lordship on edge and thirsty for blood. He has ordered the western wing of the keep, the beautiful chambers of the tragically departed Lady Ahnrun converted into an armory the likes of which the world has never seen. On size alone, it will be something to behold and a fit memorial to our brave, fierce, and beloved Lady of Gravehal.

He has asked me to serve him as his Master-at-Arms, training the men of the keep to fight the monster and any others lurking in the dark places of this uncalmingly strange land. Over my protests-I am still, age aside, vigorous enough to slay the beast single handed-he ordered it so, and I have come to agree.

We've had curious little need for martial training since arriving here (as if something were keeping the wild beasts at bay), and few but me have had the years of battle hardening needed to teach men to fight. Moreover, though I think such things a pile of Jottun offal, a strange ability has blossomed in me since arriving here. Long have I been able to oversee the fighting of men and see through the speed and clamor of the battle to find flaws in technique and minute adjustments to make the men in question better fighters. Now, though, my sight has been changed. I see before me, as if written in bright letters in the air, precisely how effective a student's attack has been. It matters not whether he attacks with magic or steel.

I suppose that I am the only man who can ready us to avenge Lady Ahnrun and protect the keep from whatever comes after Draug.
japanese:
おぞましきドラウグどもによる我らが城への冒とくにより、王はいら立ちを感じられ、血を欲せられているようです。王は城の西棟である、不運にも早世されたレディー・アーンルンの美しき居室を、この世の者が目にしたこののないような武器庫に変更され、規模の面だけでも見応えは多分にあり、我らの勇敢にして勇猛、そして人々に愛されたレディー・グレイバルにふさわしい碑と言えるでしょう。

私は王から警備主任として仕えるよう命じられ、ドラウグだけでなく、この不穏にも奇妙な地の暗き場所に潜むその他の脅威と戦えるよう、城の兵たちを鍛えるのが任となりました。歳さえ鑑みなければ私自身、王の命さえあれば単身であやつらを仕留めて見せるほどの活力を残しておりますゆえ、だいぶ異論を申し上げたのですが、御意に従うことにいたしました。

我らはこの地に到着して以来、軍事訓練の必要性が妙に下がっていますが(まるで何かが野獣どもを追い払っているかのようです)、兵に兵法を教えられるほど熟練した者が私以外に大勢いるわけではなく。またさらには、私自身はジョタンのはらわたくらいの価値しか見出さないのですが、ここに着いてから奇妙な能力が備わったのです。戦う兵たちを俯瞰し、戦場の勢いと喧騒を通じて兵の技の弱点を指摘し、細やかな修正により兵たちを向上させることは昔から得意なのですが、今や視界そのものが変わってしまったのです。私は眼前に、まるで宙に明るい文字で書かれたかのように、使っているのが剣であれ魔法であれ、兵の攻撃の威力が正確に把握できるようになったのです。

となれば、兵を鍛えてレディー・アーンルンの仇討ちに備えさせ、ドラウグ以後に城を襲ってくるであろう脅威に対処させうるのは私しかいないのでしょう。
chinese:
巨魔德拉格对我们城堡的亵渎已经让领主大人感到不安，并且渴望流血。他下令将城堡的西翼，即不幸去世的安芮恩夫人的漂亮房间改造成世界上从未出现过的军械库。单就规模而言，它很值得一看，是对我们勇敢、凶猛、敬爱的格雷夫霍夫人的恰当纪念。

他要我做他的侍卫长，训练城堡里的人去对付这个怪物和其他潜伏在这片不平静的奇异土地上的黑暗角落里的东西。我对此表示抗议——撇开年龄不谈，我仍然精力充沛，足以单手杀死这头野兽——但他却不理会我的抗议，就这样下了命令，我也只好同意。

自从来到这里后，我们就很少需要什么奇怪的军事训练（就好像有什么东西挡住了野兽一样），而且除了我之外，很少有人的战斗资历能达到教别人作战的程度。而且，虽然我认为这些东西是一堆约坦杂碎，但自从我来到这里，一种奇怪的能力就在我身上形成了。长久以来，我一直能够监督战士们的战斗，看透战斗的速度和花哨，找出技术上的缺陷并进行细微的调整，使他们成为更好的战士。但现在，我的视界改变了。我现在能精准地看到学生的攻击到底有多有效，就好像相关信息被用文字写在了我面前的空气中一样。他是用魔法还是武器攻击并不重要。

我想，我是唯一一个能让我们做好准备，为安芮恩夫人报仇，并保护城堡不受德拉格之后任何敌人的来犯的人。

그레이브홀의 제2대 영주 안스가르 솔스바르드의 명에 따라, 이곳에 청원 심의 내용을 기록한다.

스타그 니올프가 가장 먼저 옥좌 앞으로 나아와, 바라린 섬 토착 해충의 성가신 둥지를 없애 달라고 영주께 겸손히 청했다. 그의 말에 따르면 스캐브들이 거듭 밭을 망쳐 놓았고 작은 가축 몇 마리까지 물고 갔다고 한다. 영주께서는 옥좌에서 이렇게 맹세하셨다. “내 무릎 위에서 놈들의 껍데기를 깨부수고, 안에서 흘러나오는 사악한 것까지 마셔서 그 역병을 없애 주마.”

청원 심의는 엠버딥에서 영주의 승인을 받으러 온 후보 세 명이 도착하면서 중단되었다. 한 달 전 소의회가 모였을 때 그레이브홀 영주는 회랑을 (판독 불가) 가장 훌륭한 (판독 불가)로 꾸미라고 명하고, 임무에 맞는 이를 찾으라고 옵시디언 제도에 지시를 보냈다.

레이디 그레이브홀은 대연회장 위층 방을 좀 더 실용적인 용도로 쓰자고 계속 영주께 간청하지만, 영주께서는 언제나처럼 꿈쩍도 하지 않으셨다.

마지막으로 영주 앞에 선 이는 엠버딥 의회의 명으로 최근 도착한 자칭 시인이었다. 그는 바라린 섬을 듣기 좋은 시로 찬양해 하층민과 상인 계층의 마음을 사로잡고, 새 드베르가 영토로 이주하게 하라는 의회의 칙령을 내놓았다. 영주께서는 손에 흙 한 번 묻히지 않은 전령을 못마땅해하셨지만, 옵시디언 섬의 후원자들이 원하는 허접한 글을 쓰도록 두 달 동안 묵게 해 주셨다. 영주께서는 정착민들이 도착하면 엠버딥이 배를 불태우는 방안도 고려해야 한다고 덧붙이셨다. 시인의 이야기로 꾸민 진실을 보고 그들이 돌아가려 들지 못하게 말이다.

그 뒤의 안건은 모두 그날 밤의 혼인 잔치에 관한 것이었다. 이에 영주께서는 나머지 일을 유능한 레이디 그레이브홀의 손에 맡기셨다. 왕국의 일과 무관하므로 이곳에 기록할 필요는 없다.

english:
Here, by order of Ansgar Solsvard, Second Lord of Gravehal, are listed the hearing of petitions.

Starg Njolf was first before the throne, humbly asking his lordship to dispatch an annoying nest of Isle Varalins' indigenous pests. The scavs, he claims, have repeatedly overrun his crops and even carried off some of the smaller livestock. His lordship pledged, upon the throne, to "crack their shells upon mine own knee and drink whatever evil pours forth from within to rid you of their pestilence."

The hearing of petitions was interrupted by the arrival of a trio of candidates sent by Emberdeep for his lordship's approval. During the gathering of the small council one month past, Lord Gravehal ordered the gallery (illegible) with the finest (illegible) and sent orders to the Obsidian Isles to find one fit for the task.

Lady Gravehal continues to implore his lordship to put the room above the great hall to a more practical use, but he was as ever unmoved.

Last before his lordship, a self-styled "poet," recently arrived on the orders of the council in Emberdeep. He presented the council's edict that Isle Varalin be celebrated in flattering verse, designed to appeal to the lower and merchant classes to enthrall them into settling upon our new Dvergan realm. Lord Gravehal had little patience for the soft-handed messenger, but granted him hospitality for two months' time to scribble whatever gruel his Obsidian Island patrons desired. His lordship further recommended that Emberdeep consider burning the ships of these settlers upon their arrival lest they attempt to return upon seeing the truth gilded by the poet's stories.

All further business concerned the night's wedding feast. Hence Lord Gravehal left these matters in the able hands of Lady Gravehal. As this business concerns not matters of the realm, they need not be recorded here.
japanese:
グレイバル二代目城主、アングサル・ソルスヴァードの名において、ここに嘆願の数々を発表する。

玉座の前に最初に歩み出たのはスターグ・ニョルフで、ヴァラリン島原住の害獣の巣を上奏した。スキャブは再三作物を荒らし、時には小型の家畜さえもを奪っていくことがあるという。王は玉座より、"そやつらの殻をこの膝で砕き、中から流れ出る邪悪を飲み干してでも、その害を一掃してみせる"と公約をされた。

ここで、エンバーディープから三名の候補者が王の是認をいただきに到着したことで、嘆願は一旦中断された。ひと月前の小閣議の際に、王は最も(判読不能)を誇る画廊の(判読不能)り、オブシディアン島に指示を送って適切なものを探すように命じた。

レディー・グレイバルは王に、大広間の上の部屋をより実利的な用途にあてるよう懇願されていたが、王は相変わらず意に介さないないようだった。

最後に謁見したのはエンバーディープの議会に命じられて最近到着したという自称"詩人"であった。議会による布告で、ヴァラリン島を詩吟で絶賛し、意図としては労働階級、商人階級に働きかけて魅了し、我らの新たなドゥバーガの国に移住するよう喚起するというものであった。王は軟弱なこの使者にいら立ちをお見せになりつつも、二月の間泊め置いて、オブシディアン島の顧客らが欲しがる駄文を走り書くように取りはからった。王はまた、エンバーディープからそれら入植民の船が到着次第、火を放って船だけを沈め、詩人による虚飾が色あせても帰路に着けぬよう念を入れることを薦められた。

それ以外の用件は、全て夜の結婚披露宴に関するものであり、王はそれらの事項をレディー・グレイバルの才覚に一任されたのであった。それらは国の前途に関与するものではないため、ここでの記録は割愛する。
chinese:
按照安斯加·斯罗斯王德，格雷夫霍第二代领主的命令，将请愿听证会的内容罗列在此。

斯塔格·洛佑夫第一个向王权请愿，乞求领主消灭瓦拉林岛本土的害虫，把它们恼人的巢穴端掉。他称，这群害虫不断地糟蹋他的作物，甚至把一些小型牲畜搬走。领主在王座之上承诺，“把害虫的躯壳在膝盖上敲碎，里面涌出的邪恶统统吸干，好帮助你解决掉这些害虫。”

请愿听证会被突然前来的三名候选人打断，他们打深烬城而来，请求领主的许可。一个月后小理事会再次聚集，格雷夫霍领主下令，大殿之上的旁厅（字迹潦草）应当采用最好的装饰（字迹潦草），并下令黑曜岛挑选能够胜任之人。

格雷夫霍夫人仍旧乞求领主把大殿上面的房间用以更加实用的用途，可领主不曾动摇。

最后，一位风格独特的“诗人”近期受深烬城理事会的命令来到领主座下。他展示了理事会的法令，用褒奖之词赞美瓦拉林岛，用来吸引下层人民和商人，迷住他们，让他们在迪维尔干新王国定居。格雷夫霍领主对这个羸弱的送信人没什么耐心，不过还是好好招待了他两个月，随便他写些什么黑曜岛恩主想要的东西。领主之后又提议，定居之人到来之后，深烬城应当考虑烧掉前来的船只，以防他们在看到诗人镀金后的真相时还想回去。

接下来的事情就就是探讨当天晚上的婚宴。因此格雷夫霍领主把这些事情就都留给了能干的格雷夫霍夫人。因为这些事情跟王国之事无关，这里就不需要记载了。
